lines.say: Your foot fell asleep? Here's what's really happening.
lines.caption: Asleep

lines.say: Sitting on your leg squeezes a nerve, and the blood vessels feeding it.
lines.caption: Squeeze

lines.say: The squeezed nerve stops sending signals, so your foot goes numb.
lines.caption: Numb

lines.say: Then you stand up, and the pressure lets go.
lines.caption: Release

lines.say: The nerve wakes up and fires a burst of random signals.
lines.caption: Burst

lines.say: Your brain reads that static as pins and needles.
lines.caption: Pins
